projects.note: Carried out by NIID, which merged into JIHS in 2025.

projects.institutes: University of Nebraska Medical Center; Global Center for Health Security; NETEC
projects.title: JIHS–UNMC memorandum on high-consequence infectious disease preparedness
projects.summary: A memorandum signed in June 2025 that renews and extends to JIHS a partnership dating from 2016, covering biocontainment, clinical research networks and training exercises.
projects.note: The partnership began in 2016 with NCGM.

projects.institutes: National Institute of Public Health (NIOPH), Lao PDR
projects.title: NCGM–Lao National Institute of Public Health joint research and advisory support
projects.summary: NCGM's Bureau of International Health Cooperation (now JIHS) carries out joint research with Lao PDR's National Institute of Public Health, sends advisors, and acts as secretariat for related Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare (MHLW) projects.
projects.note: Archived NCGM page.

projects.institutes: Health Bureau, Ministry of Health and Sports, Myanmar
projects.title: NCGM–Myanmar Ministry of Health MoU
projects.summary: An MoU signed in April 2014 for joint research, mainly through JICA projects.
projects.note: Archived NCGM page.

projects.institutes: Tribhuvan University Institute of Medicine
projects.title: NCGM–Tribhuvan University Institute of Medicine MoU
projects.summary: An MoU signed in 2013 for collaborative research and human resource development.
projects.note: Archived NCGM page.

projects.institutes: Bach Mai Hospital; Cho Ray Hospital
projects.title: NCGM overseas base and MoUs with Bach Mai and Cho Ray hospitals
projects.summary: NCGM has run an overseas base at Bach Mai Hospital since 2005 and holds MoUs with Bach Mai and Cho Ray hospitals (Cho Ray signed 2014) covering research, training and hospital management.
projects.note: Archived NCGM page. JICA cooperation dates from 1995.

projects.institutes: National Maternal and Child Health Centre, Cambodia
projects.title: NCGM–Cambodia National Maternal and Child Health Centre MoU
projects.summary: An MoU covering technical support, research and training, building on about 20 years of expert dispatch to the centre.
projects.note: Archived NCGM page.

projects.institutes: Africa CDC
projects.title: EU for health security in Africa: ECDC for Africa CDC
projects.summary: EU-funded (EUR 9 million to ECDC plus EUR 1 million to Africa CDC) four-year capacity project in which ECDC supports Africa CDC on preparedness and emergency operations, harmonised surveillance and epidemic intelligence, and public health workforce development.
projects.note: Distinct from the separate Africa CDC–ECDC MoU. Funded by DG DEVCO/INTPA; agreement concluded Oct 2020, effective 1 Jan 2021. Later described as a five-year project that concluded in April 2025 (ECDC experts also deployed via EU Health Task Force); succeeded by an MoU (2026) and a Team Europe AMR/One Health initiative.

projects.institutes: African Union Commission / Africa CDC
projects.title: US–African Union memorandum of cooperation to establish Africa CDC
projects.summary: 2015 memorandum under which US CDC provided technical expertise and planning support to create Africa CDC, including two long-term US CDC advisors seconded to the AU and fellowships for 10 African epidemiologists.

projects.institutes: Ethiopian Public Health Institute (EPHI)
projects.title: China CDC – EPHI memorandum of understanding
projects.summary: MoU signed by video link in August 2022 covering infectious disease prevention and control, maternal and child nutrition, and laboratory testing capacity, with interest in China's malaria-elimination experience.

projects.institutes: Ethiopian Public Health Institute (EPHI); Africa CDC; Armauer Hansen Research Institute
projects.title: China CDC delegation visit to EPHI and Africa CDC for joint research planning
projects.summary: September 2025 China CDC delegation visit assessing EPHI, AHRI and Africa CDC capacities on HIV, hepatitis and malaria testing and surveillance, to prepare joint China–Africa research projects in Ethiopia.

projects.institutes: Zambia National Public Health Institute (ZNPHI)
projects.title: China CDC – ZNPHI memorandum of understanding
projects.summary: MoU signed in July 2019 between China CDC and Zambia's national public health institute focusing on public health capacity building, health informatics and laboratory strengthening.

projects.institutes: International Vaccine Institute (IVI, Seoul)
projects.title: ZNPHI – International Vaccine Institute MoU on vaccine manufacturing
projects.summary: MoU signed in Lusaka in September 2025 to build Zambia's capacity across the vaccine and therapeutics value chain, from pre-clinical development to manufacturing and market access.
projects.note: IVI is an international organisation headquartered in South Korea, not a national public health institute.

projects.institutes: National Public Health Agency of Sierra Leone (NPHA); Ministry of Health Sierra Leone; Africa CDC
projects.title: China CDC – NPHA Sierra Leone seminar on priority infectious diseases and lab capacity
projects.summary: Joint seminar in Freetown (November 2025) on malaria, Lassa fever and HIV control, surveillance and laboratory networks, agreeing priorities on sustainable laboratory systems and staff training.
projects.note: Distinct from the earlier BSL-3 lab and China–UK capacity entries; Ethiopia stands for Africa CDC participation.

projects.institutes: Rwanda Biomedical Centre (RBC)
projects.title: TRIBE-HUB – Transforming Rwanda's Biomedical Centre into an excellence hub for national and regional public health
projects.summary: EU-funded (about EUR 3.9 million) Support to African Public Health Institutes project strengthening RBC as Rwanda's NPHI, its digital health capacity and its links with European and African public health institutes.

projects.institutes: Public Health Institute of Malawi (PHIM); Ministry of Health Malawi
projects.title: Support to the Public Health Institute of Malawi (Team Europe NPHI initiative)
projects.summary: Four-year EUR 4.6 million EU/BMZ co-financed project launched June 2025 to strengthen PHIM and its collaboration with African and European national public health institutes.

projects.institutes: Ministry of Health and Child Care Zimbabwe; WHO
projects.title: EU support to establish Zimbabwe's first National Public Health Institute
projects.summary: EUR 4.2 million four-year EU investment, implemented with WHO, to set up Zimbabwe's NPHI and connect it with African and European public health institutes that run similar models.
projects.note: Start year not stated on the page.

projects.actor: European Commission with 12 EU Member States
projects.institutes: Africa CDC; IANPHI; WHO; African NPHIs
projects.title: Team Europe Initiative: Strengthening Public Health Institutes in Africa (TEI PHI)
projects.summary: Launched March 2024 by the European Commission, 12 EU Member States and Africa CDC to strengthen African NPHIs' institutional capacity, regional collaboration and workforce, including linking European and African public health institutes; a EUR 50 million regional programme is implemented by Belgium, France, Germany, Sweden and WHO.
projects.note: Partner list = countries the source names as well supported by European NPHI-related support; Ethiopia = Africa CDC. Country projects (e.g. Rwanda, Malawi, Zimbabwe, Burundi, Guinea/DRC) are listed separately.

projects.actor: Institut de Veille Sanitaire (InVS, now Santé publique France)
projects.institutes: Institut National d'Hygiène (INH), Morocco
projects.title: EU twinning to modernise Morocco's Institut National d'Hygiène
projects.summary: EU-funded twinning under the EU–Morocco Association Agreement, launched January 2009, in which InVS and other French bodies (AFNOR, CHU de Rouen, CNEH, ADETEF) helped Morocco's INH meet international public health and health-security standards.
projects.note: EU budget about MAD 14 million; actions planned over 2008–2010.

projects.institutes: West African Health Organisation (WAHO); ECOWAS Regional Centre for Surveillance and Disease Control (RCSDC); national public health institutes of priority countries
projects.title: Support to the Regional Centre for Surveillance and Disease Control in the ECOWAS zone
projects.summary: Three-year EU-funded project implemented by GIZ within the BMZ Regional Programme Support to Pandemic Prevention in the ECOWAS Region, strengthening WAHO's RCSDC and surveillance (incl. SORMAS) with priority countries Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone and Togo.
projects.note: Launch year inferred (page refers to 2019 as the past year); RCSDC is in Abuja, WAHO HQ in Bobo-Dioulasso.

projects.institutes: Ministry of Health and Population (MoHP) Egypt; Central Public Health Laboratories
projects.title: International Emerging Infections Program (IEIP) Egypt
projects.summary: CDC–MoHP programme established in 2005 in Damanhur to strengthen disease surveillance, laboratory diagnostics, data management and training, intended as a model for expansion across the Nile Delta and to support Egypt's role as an Africa CDC regional centre.

projects.actor: Ethiopian Public Health Institute (EPHI) with Africa CDC
projects.institutes: NPHIs / public health agencies of Comoros, Madagascar, Rwanda (RBC), Somalia, South Sudan and Tanzania
projects.title: Africa CDC NPHI Peer-to-Peer Learning Programme hosted by EPHI
projects.summary: EPHI hosted directors-general and delegates from six Eastern African member states for a week of peer learning on surveillance, emergency preparedness, laboratory systems, research, workforce and health information, under Africa CDC's NPHI peer-to-peer programme.
projects.note: Comoros also participated (not in atlas). Held 25 Sep–1 Oct 2023.

projects.institutes: Nigeria Centre for Disease Control and Prevention (NCDC); UK Health Security Agency (UKHSA)
projects.title: ZNPHI study visit to NCDC Nigeria and joint EOC simulation exercise
projects.summary: ZNPHI's director-general led a March 2022 delegation, accompanied by UKHSA, to NCDC to observe a multi-state emergency operations centre simulation exercise and discuss a peer-to-peer exchange programme between the two institutes.

projects.institutes: Africa CDC; NCDC Nigeria; US CDC; IANPHI; NPHIs and ministries of 13 ECOWAS countries
projects.title: West Africa NPHI acceleration workshop (WAHO, Africa CDC, NCDC, US CDC, IANPHI)
projects.summary: March 2024 workshop in Abuja where established, recent and nascent West African NPHIs shared lessons and drafted stage-appropriate action plans for establishing or strengthening their institutes, with requested partner support.
projects.note: Cabo Verde also participated (not in atlas). Burkina Faso also participated; it is WAHO's seat.

projects.institutes: South Sudan Ministry of Health and line ministries; Africa CDC
projects.title: Africa CDC AMR surveillance peer-to-peer exchange: South Sudan at NICD
projects.summary: Five-day 2025 visit, organised by Africa CDC, in which NICD's AMR and healthcare-associated infections centre (CHARM) shared laboratory, susceptibility testing, quality assurance and data management practice with a South Sudanese delegation to strengthen its national AMR surveillance.
projects.note: Ethiopia stands for Africa CDC as organiser.

projects.actor: Africa CDC Southern Africa Regional Collaborating Centre with ZNPHI
projects.institutes: Africa CDC; US CDC; IANPHI; NPHIs of Lesotho, Malawi, Mozambique (INS), Namibia, South Africa (NICD) and Zimbabwe
projects.title: Southern Africa summit on establishing and strengthening NPHIs
projects.summary: Three-day September 2019 meeting in Livingstone where Southern African NPHIs held peer exchanges on core functions, lessons and strategies, and agreed that exchange visits and peer mentorship are critical to NPHI development.

projects.actor: China CDC National Institute of Parasitic Diseases
projects.institutes: Theodor Bilharz Research Institute; Ain Shams University; Ministry of Health and Population Egypt; Academy of Scientific Research and Technology
projects.title: China–Egypt collaborative research on schistosomiasis and other vector-borne tropical diseases
projects.summary: NSFC-funded joint research project; an August 2024 China CDC delegation visit held a progress meeting and discussed schistosomiasis and malaria control, research and training, aiming at a longer-term China–Africa tropical disease cooperation platform.
projects.note: Project start year not stated; 2024 is the visit year.

projects.institutes: Africa CDC (Wu Lien-teh Laboratory); trainees from 16 African countries
projects.title: China CDC – Africa CDC overseas laboratory technology training programme
projects.summary: Three-week programme opened 3 November 2025 at Africa CDC headquarters training 30 participants from 16 countries in pathogen detection, sequencing and bioinformatics, AMR surveillance and lab quality management.
projects.note: A specific activity under the broader China CDC–Africa CDC cooperation (listed separately). Only Zambia is named among the 16 trainee countries.

projects.institutes: Health professionals from African ministries and public health agencies
projects.title: Training course on emerging and re-emerging infectious disease control for Africa
projects.summary: Two-week foreign-aid course (September 2025) sponsored by China's Ministry of Commerce and run by China CDC for 22 African health professionals on surveillance, laboratory testing, outbreak control and emergency response.

projects.institutes: Africa CDC (incl. Central Africa Regional Coordinating Centre, Libreville); Ministry of Health Gabon
projects.title: Africa CDC–ECDC antimicrobial stewardship training in Gabon
projects.summary: September 2025 national One Health antimicrobial stewardship training in Lambaréné, co-organised by Africa CDC, ECDC and Gabon's Ministry of Health with a Gabon-adapted curriculum, under the AMR work package of the Africa CDC–ECDC partnership project.

projects.institutes: Africa CDC; African Society for Laboratory Medicine (ASLM); EDCTP; Danish Ministry of Foreign Affairs; ICARS
projects.title: Team Europe Initiative action: Fighting AMR and strengthening the One Health workforce in Africa
projects.summary: Team Europe action with Africa CDC, launched in Addis Ababa in May 2026 after a Danish-funded inception phase, in which ECDC, EDCTP and ASLM support AMR control and One Health workforce development in Africa.
projects.note: A March 2026 report says a new five-year ECDC–Africa CDC initiative under this TEI starts May 2026 (with EFSA).

projects.actor: Africa CDC with African Society for Laboratory Medicine (ASLM)
projects.institutes: European Union (Team Europe Initiative on Sustainable Health Security); Ethiopian Public Health Institute and national AMR reference laboratories
projects.title: ARILAC – Advancing Regional Integrated Laboratory Capacity for AMR Control
projects.summary: Four-year EU-supported One Health laboratory initiative launched May 2026 to strengthen integrated laboratory-based AMR surveillance and lab capacity in eight AU member states.
projects.note: Ethiopia is also a target country. Belgium = EU (Brussels) as funder.

projects.institutes: Rwanda Biomedical Centre (RBC); Africa CDC
projects.title: Africa CDC–ECDC R data-analysis training for Rwanda Biomedical Centre experts
projects.summary: May 2025 hands-on R training for 15 RBC surveillance experts using local datasets, delivered with Africa CDC under the Africa CDC–ECDC partnership project as a pilot for country-specific trainings in other AU member states.

projects.actor: National Public Health Agency of Sierra Leone (NPHA) (host)
projects.institutes: Ministry of Health Mozambique (National Directorate of Public Health); WHO country office Sierra Leone
projects.title: Mozambique Ministry of Health South–South learning visit to Sierra Leone
projects.summary: March 2024 WHO-facilitated exchange in which a Mozambican delegation led by the National Director of Public Health learned from NPHA and Sierra Leone's ministry about public health emergency management, surveillance and emergency operations centres.

projects.institutes: National public health institutes of North African AU member states
projects.title: Africa CDC peer-to-peer and twinning programme between North African NPHIs
projects.summary: Africa CDC programme, financed by the World Bank Africa CDC Support Program (P178633), to establish and strengthen NPHIs in North Africa, including support for peer-to-peer learning and twinning between NPHIs in the region.
projects.note: Source is a 2023 consultant ToR; implementation status not confirmed. Sahrawi Republic listed as member state (mapped to W. Sahara). An earlier equivalent for other regions was AfDB-funded.

projects.actor: Nigeria Centre for Disease Control and Prevention (NCDC)
projects.institutes: Nagasaki University; JICA
projects.title: NCDC – Nagasaki University partnership under JICA PREPARE
projects.summary: Nagasaki University has hosted long-term NCDC trainees through JICA's PREPARE programme on infectious disease countermeasures and research; a January 2025 visit by NCDC's director-general agreed to deepen ties via a future JICA technical cooperation project.
projects.note: Nagasaki University is an academic partner, not an NPHI. Start year of trainee placements not stated.

projects.actor: Lithuanian consortium led by Vilnius University Hospital Santaros Klinikos (with National Public Health Surveillance Laboratory, Health Emergency Situations Centre, National Blood Center, CPVA)
projects.institutes: L. Sakvarelidze National Center for Disease Control and Public Health (NCDC); Ministry of IDPs, Labour, Health and Social Affairs of Georgia
projects.title: EU Twinning: Enhance national disease surveillance in Georgia through improved epidemiological and molecular (genomic) surveillance
projects.summary: Lithuanian-led EU Twinning (EUR 1.2 million) strengthening NCDC Georgia's epidemiological and genomic surveillance in line with EU rules under the Association Agreement.
projects.note: CPVA page gives 2024–2025; Lithuanian development cooperation map (ltaid.urm.lt) gives 2024–2026 (24+3 months).

projects.actor: Lithuanian consortium (National Blood Centre, Vilnius University, National Public Health Surveillance Laboratory) with Sanquin (Netherlands)
projects.institutes: National Center for Disease Control and Public Health (NCDC); Ministry of IDPs, Labour, Health and Social Affairs of Georgia
projects.title: EU Twinning: Strengthening Blood Safety System in Georgia
projects.summary: EU Twinning launched in September 2020 that revised Georgia's blood-safety legal framework, assessed blood banks and supported reorganising transfusion services and lab capacity with NCDC Georgia.
projects.note: Launched Sept 2020 (24 months per ltaid.urm.lt Lithuanian project map, which lists Lithuania as lead); end year inferred. EEAS launch article names Sanquin as a partner.

projects.institutes: Public Health Institution of Turkey (Ministry of Health); Ghent University; Amsterdam UMC
projects.title: ESPrIT – Strengthening the occupational health expertise and scientific capacity of the Public Health Institution of Turkey
projects.summary: Horizon 2020 Twinning that used training, mentoring and staff exchanges to build PHIT's research capacity on occupational diseases and national data collection.
projects.note: Coordinator formally the Turkish Ministry of Health; TNO is the main EU partner. Horizon 2020 twinning, not the EU institutional Twinning instrument.

projects.institutes: European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC)
projects.title: UKHSA–ECDC Memorandum of Understanding
projects.summary: MoU signed on 1 December 2021 by Jenny Harries and Andrea Ammon to cooperate on epidemic intelligence, risk assessment, lab capacity for emerging threats, AMR and healthcare-associated infections.
projects.note: No end date published. Followed by a data sharing agreement in early 2025 giving UKHSA EpiPulse access (UK the first third country to sign one with ECDC), per UKHSA board paper AB-25-039.

projects.institutes: National partners in nine countries/territories; WHO EMRO sequencing hubs (Oman, Abu Dhabi, Morocco); Africa CDC; CARPHA
projects.title: New Variant Assessment Platform (NVAP) – international genomic surveillance partnerships
projects.summary: Set up by PHE in 2021 and continued by UKHSA, NVAP provides sequencing reagents, training in bioinformatics and variant risk assessment, and scientific exchanges to partner countries and regional bodies.
projects.note: As of May 2022, also Cayman Islands and Singapore (not in atlas). Guidance page last updated 2026.

projects.institutes: National Center for Disease Control and Public Health (NCDC); Lugar Center for Public Health Research
projects.title: CDC–Georgia NCDC partnership
projects.summary: Long-standing CDC collaboration with Georgia's NCDC since 1995 on field epidemiology training, the Lugar Center lab (AMR EQA, regional genomic hub), emergency management, hepatitis C elimination and workforce strategy.
projects.note: Georgia designated a US Intensive Support Partner Country for Health Security in 2023.

projects.institutes: Agence Nationale de Sécurité Sanitaire (ANSS); Institut National de Santé Publique (INSP)
projects.title: CDC support to Guinea's ANSS
projects.summary: Since opening an office in 2015, CDC has helped ANSS build a multitiered surveillance and response structure (rapid response teams, EOCs, 7-1-7 approach with DHIS2) and supports FETP and INSP lab strengthening.

projects.institutes: Institute of Epidemiology, Disease Control and Research (IEDCR); icddr,b
projects.title: CDC–IEDCR partnership in Bangladesh
projects.summary: CDC has partnered with IEDCR since the 2001 Nipah outbreak on outbreak response, influenza and priority-pathogen surveillance, FETP, lab and genomic capacity, and the national public health EOC.

projects.institutes: National Institute of Health (NIH) Islamabad
projects.title: CDC–Pakistan NIH cooperation (surveillance, FELTP, GLLP)
projects.summary: Under a cooperative agreement with Pakistan's NIH, CDC supported influenza sentinel surveillance from 2004, FELTP from 2006 (handed to government in 2021) and the Global Laboratory Leadership Programme from 2019.
projects.note: The general CDC NPHI development entry already lists Pakistan; this entry covers the specific surveillance/training cooperation.

projects.institutes: Uganda National Institute of Public Health (UNIPH); Ministry of Health PHEOC
projects.title: CDC–UNIPH collaboration (FETP, Laboratory Leadership Program, PHEOC)
projects.summary: CDC supported Uganda's PHEOC (2013), FETP (2015) and launched the Laboratory Leadership Program with UNIPH to strengthen lab management and leadership.

projects.institutes: Zambia National Public Health Institute (ZNPHI); Zambia National Public Health Reference Laboratory
projects.title: CDC funding for ZNPHI genomic sequencing capacity
projects.summary: During a November 2023 high-level visit, CDC confirmed US$2.5 million to expand genomic sequencing at Zambia's national public health reference lab for national and regional use.
projects.note: Zambia is also in the general CDC NPHI support entries.

projects.institutes: Chief State Sanitary Doctor of Ukraine / Ministry of Health of Ukraine
projects.title: Ukraine–Poland agreement on cooperation in public health (border exercises, epidemiological data exchange)
projects.summary: December 2025 agreement between the two chief sanitary officers on IHR implementation, infectious-disease data exchange, joint border-region preparedness, training and alignment with EU standards, including lab diagnostics and AMR.
projects.note: Signed under the 28 March 2024 MoU between the two health ministries. NPHIs (PHC Ukraine, NIZP PZH-PIB) are not named as parties.

projects.actor: France–Netherlands twinning consortium (French Ministry of Health lead)
projects.institutes: Agence Nationale de Contrôle Sanitaire et Environnemental des Produits (ANCSEP)
projects.title: EU Twinning: strengthening control of health and environmental risks (ANCSEP, Tunisia)
projects.summary: EUR 1 million EU Twinning (Sept 2015–Sept 2017) under the PACS programme helping Tunisia's ANCSEP improve health and environmental risk assessment and management, including legislative alignment.
projects.note: Project newsletter (EHESP site) cites ANSES, ANSM, EFSA and RIVM; exact member-state implementing bodies not confirmed. Lead institution assumed French.

projects.institutes: Ministry of Health of Turkey; Public Health Institution of Turkey; provincial Public Health Directorates
projects.title: EU Twinning TR08-EN-05: Emergency case management and risk analysis in drinking water for the protection of public health in Turkey
projects.summary: Italian-led EU Twinning (2012–2013) with ISS building the Turkish health ministry's capacity for drinking-water risk assessment, early warning and emergency management in line with the EU Drinking Water Directive.
projects.note: Italy listed as leader in Turkish EU Ministry twinning list; ISS named as the Italian party (lead role inferred).

projects.actor: International Office for Water (OIEau) for the French Ministry of Social Affairs and Health
projects.institutes: Public Health Institution of Turkey (THSK)
projects.title: EU Twinning TR-10-IB-EN-02: Alignment in bathing water monitoring (Turkey)
projects.summary: French-led EU Twinning with an Italian junior partner, started January 2013, training about 150 Public Health Institution of Turkey staff in bathing-water quality monitoring and management under EU rules.
projects.note: End year inferred from the initial two-year duration. Beneficiary is Turkey's NPHI; the provider is not an NPHI.

projects.institutes: Ministry of Health of Serbia; national reference laboratories; Institute of Public Health of Serbia 'Dr Milan Jovanović Batut'
projects.title: EU Twinning Light: Improving microbiology diagnostic system quality for communicable disease surveillance in Serbia
projects.summary: Italian–Serbian Twinning Light in which ISS-led experts carried out a gap assessment (Sept–Dec 2017) of Serbia's microbiology laboratory system against EU surveillance standards and the acquis.
projects.note: Twinning Light status and March 2018 completion come from the Serbia twinning fiche SR 20 IPA HE 01 22 (fm.gov.lv/lv/media/12410/download). The Batut institute's participation is assumed, not confirmed.

projects.institutes: Ministry of Health of Vietnam; National Influenza Centers (Hanoi, Ho Chi Minh City)
projects.title: CDC–Vietnam health security partnership
projects.summary: CDC has worked in Vietnam since 1998, supporting influenza surveillance (from 2005), FETP (from 2007, ~1,400 trained), lab accreditation, genome sequencing, AMR detection and lab leadership training with the Ministry of Health.
projects.note: Partner is the Ministry of Health rather than a single NPHI; see also IANPHI–CDC Vietnam NPHI creation entry.

projects.institutes: Kenya National Public Health Institute (KNPHI); Ministry of Health
projects.title: CDC and IANPHI support for establishing the Kenya National Public Health Institute
projects.summary: CDC sponsored a 2020 Nairobi planning workshop with IANPHI and hosted a Kenyan delegation in 2024 ahead of KNPHI's operational launch in May 2025, which took over the PHEOC, surveillance, port health and FELTP from the ministry.
projects.note: KNPHI established by Legal Notice No. 14 of 18 Jan 2022. Status is completed for the establishment phase; the wider CDC–Kenya partnership continues.

projects.institutes: Communicable Diseases Agency (CDA), Singapore
projects.title: UKHSA–Singapore Communicable Diseases Agency Memorandum of Understanding
projects.summary: MoU signed in late 2024 between UKHSA and Singapore's new Communicable Diseases Agency on health security cooperation.
projects.note: Partner country is Singapore, which is not in the world-atlas 110m map. Source is a UKHSA board paper on global health activities (2025).

projects.institutes: Africa CDC (Addis Ababa)
projects.title: UKHSA support to Africa CDC (staff secondment, African Volunteers Health Corps, outbreak response)
projects.summary: UKHSA seconds a staff member to the Africa CDC Director General's office and supports the African Volunteers Health Corps, continental outbreak response and IHR-SP regional work. The UK and Africa CDC held their first high-level health dialogue in November 2025.
projects.note: Start year is the reporting year 2024/25. Ethiopia stands in for Africa CDC headquarters. No UKHSA–Africa CDC MoU was found. Dialogue communiqué: gov.uk, 25 Nov 2025.

projects.institutes: US CDC; Australian CDC; Public Health Agency of Canada; New Zealand public health agency
projects.title: Five-nation public health institute exchanges on data sharing, digitalisation and AI
projects.summary: UKHSA held regular meetings in 2024/25 with the public health institutes of the US, Australia, Canada and New Zealand on data sharing, digitalisation and artificial intelligence.
projects.note: Partner institute names are inferred; the source says only 'Public Health Institutes of the US, Australia, Canada and New Zealand'.

projects.institutes: Santé publique France
projects.title: UKHSA mass-gatherings support to Santé publique France for Paris 2024
projects.summary: UKHSA advised Santé publique France on mass-gathering health protection for the Paris 2024 Olympic and Paralympic Games.

projects.institutes: National Institute for Communicable Diseases (NICD)
projects.title: UKHSA support to South Africa's NICD for the mpox response
projects.summary: In 2024 UKHSA gave technical support to South Africa's NICD for its mpox outbreak response.
projects.note: Distinct from the older HPA–NICD north/south collaboration.
